Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

frpp 0.0.0.9000

  • Add a quick joint regression runner with a fixed small fitting fixture, isolated test sessions and source/installed-code provenance. Keep saved-fit replay and expensive full re-estimation as separate validation steps.

  • Convert fspec to an independent S4 composition class with typed slots, semantic validation, component accessors and S3/S4 method dispatch. Upgrade earlier S3 specifications and fitted models while retaining list-style component access, callback bindings, calculation and RNG behavior.

  • Verify the 10,000-row migrated fit against the original emhawkes interface in three paired repetitions; document exact estimates and optimizer curvature, restored likelihoods, unavailable Wald covariance and elapsed fitting times.

  • Preserve the full original emhawkes FRPP examples in a compatibility vignette, alongside the new-interface examples. Document the planned migration while retaining simple residual-law uses and Hawkes residual diagnostics in emhawkes.

  • Add fsim() as the primary simulation function. Existing simulate() methods call it, preserving path and RNG behavior and old serialized classes.

  • Assemble numeric state-backend likelihoods using the experimental public emhawkes::exp_kernel_replay() interface, without Hawkes likelihood evaluation or full component histories when inference is not requested. This requires the emhawkes development interface; the bridge remains available with 1.0.0.

  • Use fspec() as the primary composition constructor. Keep frpp_spec() and old serialized classes compatible; add as_fspec().

  • Add ffit() with maxLik and stats optimizers, optional joint residual estimation, shared/fixed parameters, constraints and a domain validator.

  • Add fitted-model restoration, initialization replay, coefficient, likelihood, covariance, summary and diagnostic methods. Residual parameters stay fixed by default; invalid Wald covariance is withheld rather than repaired.

Developed by Kyungsub Lee.
